title: refactor(desktop): drop the Record button from the screenshot bar
body:
## What was removed

In the capture overlay opened for a screenshot (capture intent), the action bar no longer has the Record button or the R shortcut. It now shows: P/V switch, mode pills, Capture (Enter), Copy (Cmd+C), Cancel. This applies to every place that bar is drawn in capture intent: the Frame toolbar, the Window picker and the Screen card (they share `ActionButtons`).

## Why

The P (photo) / V (video) intent switch at the left of the bar already turns the same selection into a recording. A Record button next to Capture duplicated it and competed with the primary action. Owner decision.

## What stays in record intent

- The Window picker still draws this bar opened to record, Record first then Capture (Record stays disabled there, as before: a window cannot be recorded).
- R still works in record intent (alias of Enter); Cmd/Ctrl+R remain excluded.
- Frame and Screen record chrome is untouched.
- No i18n keys were removed: `overlay.record` and the record hints are still used by record intent. The hint pills never mentioned R.

## Docs

- Spec `2026-10-26-record-capture-modes-design.md`: the capture-intent bar has no Record button because P/V covers it (two places).
- ADR 0024: added a dated note under "Notes" that the spec superseded the reserved Record seat; accepted text is not rewritten.

## Verification

- `bun run check-types`, `bun run lint` (0 errors, 17 pre-existing warnings) and the full app `vitest run` pass.
- Tests: removed the Record click tests in capture intent; added one asserting the capture toolbar has no Record and R answers nothing; added one for the record-intent Window picker still drawing Record first; `actionForKey` tests now assert R is ignored in capture intent and works in record intent.

## Not verified

Not run visually in the real Electron overlay; toolbar width constants were not changed, so the bar is now slightly wider than its content needs (about one button). Worth a quick look.
